rule: an OWNER_APPROVED record replaces the base record with the same rule_id (or adds a new rule); a PROPOSED record is ignored unless the caller asks for proposals; the base file is never edited; frozen results keep the version they were computed with

records.rule_name: An open-edge guardrail is measured along its actual installed sloping path
records.calculation_method: per open-edge rail segment: straight sloped segment L = sqrt(H^2 + V^2); horizontal landing segment L = H (added when it is part of the same installed system); curved / helical L = sqrt((r*theta)^2 + V^2); shared vertices counted once; without drawn rail extents the flight's nosing pitch line H = (n-1)*going, V = (n-1)*riser
never: the plan projection as the billed length
reported_separately: H, V and 3D length per segment
open_questions: Q-ST-1 rail extents when not drawn
Q-ST-2 landing guard same system or separate

records.rule_name: A wall-mounted handrail is measured only where shown, specified or owner-confirmed
records.calculation_method: the UP-STAIR-012 3D path method along the wall-side rail line; its own BOQ line when the system differs from the guardrail

records.rule_name: The wet-room membrane turns up 0.20 m around the whole boundary, doorway included
records.calculation_method: UPTURN_PERIMETER_LM = the full boundary of the waterproofed floor including every doorway / threshold segment (door openings are not deducted); UPTURN_M2 = UPTURN_PERIMETER_LM x 0.20
records.construction_check: DOORWAY_UPTURN_DETAIL_REQUIRED on each doorway segment until the project's threshold / water-stop / return detail is known
open_questions: Q-WP-1 how the doorway 0.20 m is built and whether it is billed in addition to the doorway floor piece

records.rule_name: The floor membrane continues through the doorway; the doorway floor piece and the doorway upturn are never counted twice
records.calculation_method: doorway floor piece = door width x wall depth, part of the floor waterproofing area; the doorway segment of the upturn (UP-WP-002 v2.0.0) is its own row; where the project detail puts the 0.20 m coverage inside the doorway piece, only one is billed

records.rule_name: Openings are deducted per trade from one table; the waterproofing upturn is not deducted
records.calculation_method: per-trade opening table: SKIRTING deduct door widths (UP-CER-003); WALL_TILE gross - openings (UP-CER-005); WATERPROOFING_UPTURN no deduction (UP-WP-002 v2.0.0); PLASTER / PAINT per owner decision Q-OPN-1 (unresolved)
records.note: consequence of UP-WP-002 v2.0.0: v1.0.0 listed the waterproofing upturn among deducted quantities

records.rule_name: Wall ceramic / porcelain height is derived per face from the drawings, never a universal constant
records.calculation_method: ladder: (1) printed finish height; (2) section / RCP finished clear height; (3) derived = floor-to-floor - controlling soffit depth over the face - ceiling / services / decor zone - finished-floor build-up, each component sourced; (4) project owner fact; else BLOCKED. Each deduction once; never subtract a depth already inside a measured height

records.rule_name: Membrane material is calculated from the roll layout with a minimum 0.10 m overlap, never a flat waste rate
records.calculation_method: strips of the roll width laid across the polygon with at least the minimum side lap between adjoining strips (each additional 1.00 m strip contributes 1.00 - 0.10 = 0.90 m before edge conditions); end laps at transverse seams; upturn bands with a lap onto the floor membrane; pieces cut from rolls with offcut reuse; installed, overlap, cutting waste, reusable offcuts and packaging surplus reported separately; whole rolls from the cutting plan
never: net area / roll area as the roll count
a lap smaller than the owner minimum
procurement area as the billed quantity
records.stricter_wins: a data-sheet lap larger than 0.10 m replaces it and its source is recorded

records.rule_name: Tile cutting waste comes from the room's layout for the selected size; alternatives are recommendations only
records.calculation_method: per candidate size (120x60, 60x60, 160x80 cm or custom): layout, orientation and start alignment under the same constraints; full / cut / consumed tiles; reusable offcuts; cutting waste = consumed tile area - installed tile area - reusable offcuts retained; cutting waste % = cutting waste / net installed area x 100; packaging surplus and any owner-approved spare allowance kept separate
never: a flat size-based waste percentage as the quantity
silent substitution of the selected size
records.note: the flat percentages of the takeoff skill (60x60 10 %, 120x60 12 %, 160x80 15 %) are unconfirmed defaults; they may be shown as a reference, never used

records.rule_name: A shower takes the wet-room floor and the UP-WP-002 v2 upturn; higher tanking is separate
Railing posts, balusters and glass panels are measured only when defined
